items.item_text: Background Check: Continued employment is contingent upon the completion of a satisfactory background investigation.
Live Scan Background Check: A Live Scan background check must be completed prior to the start of employment.
Age Requirement: Candidate(s) must be 18 years or older to be eligible to be hired.
High School diploma or equivalent experience
1-3 years Experience in office administration or performing in an office environment, familiarity with office equipment and structure.

Under the general direction of the MSO, assist with the operational functions of the Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering Department. Provide administrative support to approximately 41-45 faculty and 15-20 temporary instructors per quarter related to all aspects of their academic and professional activities. Assist with recruitment efforts in the MAE Dept. Coordinate seminars, hotels, and other arrangements for visiting candidates.
1. Working knowledge of university policies and procedures.
4. Skill in working independently and following through on assignments with minimal supervision.
2. Working knowledge of University policies and procedures regarding travel and reimbursements.
5. Ability to analyze situations and define problems, objective, and identify relevant factors.
3. Demonstrated skill in the use of University purchasing and acquisitions system, policies and procedures.
6. Skill in prioritizing assignments when faced with heavy workload, competing deadlines, and compelling requests for service.
7. Interpersonal skill to interact effectively with faculty, staff, and students.
8. Demonstrated knowledge of and skill in operating the UCLA BruinBuy purchasing, Travel Express, UCPath, QDB, AIS, PPP and other systems.
9. Ability to use Microsoft Word, Excel, some knowledge of web design and computer based filing systems.
10. Ability to maintain confidentiality of records and information.
11. Demonstrated oral and written communication skills sufficient to establish effective working relations will all levels of university faculty, staff, students and outside agencies.
